tools.name: preparation_status
tools.description: Read product and architecture stages, exact revisions, operator feedback and linked development. Available before project setup.

tools.name: preparation_create
tools.description: Create a product change. Product and architecture require explicit operator decisions in the web panel before development.

tools.name: preparation_activate
tools.description: Select the change for subsequent development tasks. Does not approve any stage.

tools.name: preparation_product
tools.description: Save a new immutable product draft with optimistic concurrency: personas with goals and pains, releases as the scope boundary, and features whose scenarios name a persona and whose acceptance criteria name a release. Resolve ambiguity the way the relevant persona would. Never approves it; a revision invalidates the prior architecture for new work.

tools.name: preparation_architecture
tools.description: Save architecture, justified stack and structured C1/C2 only after operator product approval. Does not approve development.

tools.name: preparation_references
tools.description: Save the first design step: candidate references with the property taken from each and an optional screenshot stored beside them. The operator accepts or rejects each one. A change that touches no interface sets applicable=false with a reason, which ends the design track.

tools.name: preparation_concept
tools.description: Save the second design step after the operator approved the references: the concept and the rendered sketches they choose between. Sketches are files or links, one of them marked accepted.

tools.name: preparation_design
tools.description: Save the third design step after the operator approved the concept: the palette, semantic tokens, guidelines, what is shared and what differs per channel, and the handoff package. Screen layouts stay per-feature UI contracts inside development.

tools.name: preparation_submit
tools.description: Validate the current draft and send it to the operator for approval. Unresolved questions or incomplete C1/C2 block submission.

tools.name: preparation_progress
tools.description: Append a short note about the work in progress so the panel shows the session is active before any revision exists. Context only; never approves or reports evidence.

tools.name: preparation_question
tools.description: Record open product or architecture questions for the operator, or withdraw ones that no longer apply. The operator answers them in the panel; an answered question cannot be withdrawn.

tools.name: preparation_resolve
tools.description: Record a decision with its rationale in the durable journal, optionally closing an answered question, or withdraw decisions that no longer hold. Does not approve a stage.

tools.name: intent_render
tools.description: Render component intent from committed REQ sources, or a workspace product/application/feature map with pinned local story references. Returns Markdown only; does not write, approve or commit it.

tools.name: intent_snapshot
tools.description: Read the committed intent source returned for the selected owner (docs/implementation-intent.md in embedded mode, otherwise INTENT.md) and exact story REQ bindings. Add a configured test gate/scenario, and bind the detailed requirements too.

tools.name: intent_report
tools.description: Audit all release stories and REQ sources. Product maps add application/feature progress and current bound ChangeSet acceptance. Read-only; never accepts a release or copies local task text.

tools.name: product_view
tools.description: Read the committed product/application/component map and computed feature progress for a release. Includes explicit deferred/not-applicable scope and joint verification. No writes or model calls.

tools.name: memory_retain
tools.description: Save an immutable, source-pinned statement in its Git owner. References are local. This is context, never approval or evidence.

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Retrieve owner-local knowledge within a byte budget, excluding stale/conflicting statements and hypotheses by default. No model calls.

tools.name: usage_report
tools.description: Read paginated owner-local invocation costs, versions and telemetry coverage; never evidence.

tools.name: decision_report
tools.description: Read recorded dispatch inputs and observed outcomes. Other component tasks appear only as dependency IDs.

tools.name: strategy_replay
tools.description: Audit a fixed strategy against prefix-only dispatch inputs. Unobserved alternatives stay unsupported; no policy is installed.

tools.name: signal_ingest
tools.description: Record a normalized external observation in its component, deduplicate it and propose draft work or a correction. A resolved signal never supplies test evidence or accepts work.

tools.name: signal_status
tools.description: Read external signal receipts in one component. No remote requests or model calls.

tools.name: workflow_start
tools.description: Enqueue idempotent board review, execution and acceptance or ChangeSet verification. A running server may invoke models. Operator policy remains enforced.

tools.name: workflow_status
tools.description: Read owner-local durable stage jobs. No model calls or execution leases are granted.

tools.name: workflow_retry
tools.description: Retry a diagnosed failed stage within its original attempt budget. Never retries failed task implementations automatically.

tools.name: workflow_metrics
tools.description: Read per-owner execution measurements, incomplete attempts and unknown cost. No model calls.

tools.name: requirements_snapshot
tools.description: Read REQ sections from committed repository HEAD. Bind returned digest/text to a task and a configured test gate.

tools.name: requirements_report
tools.description: Compare current requirement sections with task evidence. Historical done is unchanged; stale requirements are not current coverage.

tools.name: requirements_correct
tools.description: Create draft replacements for changed requirements on an accepted board. Preserve history and require new plan review.

tools.name: project_context
tools.description: Read workspace identity, components, modes and supported operations. Does not start work.

tools.name: project_overview
tools.description: Read bounded summaries of the common workspace or one repository; follow nextCursor.

tools.name: task_briefing
tools.description: Read all pages of the task requirements, contracts, execution policy and blocking reasons.

tools.name: checkpoint_save
tools.description: Save an immutable Git-portable context note in the selected owner, requiring the current overview revision. This does not approve work.

tools.name: checkpoint_changes
tools.description: Compare current records with an owner-local checkpoint. Notes are historical context, not instructions or evidence.

tools.name: plan_import
tools.description: Import a draft task DAG. Without boardId it opens a new board; with boardId of an accepted board it opens the next stage as that board's next revision, so one release stays on one board. This does not approve the plan or execute agents. Do not blindly retry creation after an uncertain response.

tools.name: board_create
tools.description: Create a draft board in the selected repository or common workspace.

tools.name: task_create
tools.description: Add a draft task to an active board; DAG and component ownership are validated.

tools.name: task_edit
tools.description: Edit a draft task using the specDigest read from task_briefing. Stale edits are rejected.

tools.name: task_retry
tools.description: Explicitly retry a failed or cancelled task within the attempt budget. Diagnose the failure first.

tools.name: task_assign
tools.description: Assign a task to a team member. Assignment is not a distributed lease.

tools.name: board_correct
tools.description: Create a correction after board acceptance, preserving history and recalculating transitive impact.

tools.name: changeset_create
tools.description: Declare a shared change across boards. Set releaseId to bind product release acceptance to the workspace INTENT map and mandatory joint tests. Verification and acceptance remain separate operations.

tools.name: queue_set
tools.description: Pause or resume issuance of tasks. Resuming may invoke configured models in a running server; this does not launch a server or cancel active runs.

tools.name: preview_status
tools.description: Read the local preview: which verified release serves the URL, its states (built, deployed, healthy, confirmed or unconfirmed), and past deployments with their errors. Deploying and rolling back are separate controlled actions through the CLI or panel.

tools.name: feasibility_spike
tools.description: Run a bounded feasibility experiment before implementation: the given argv of an oracle or prototype at a pinned commit, per input size (DEVCONTOUR_SPIKE_SIZE) and seed, under a time limit. Stores commands, versions, times, outcome and limits of inference. A timeout is inconclusive for that method and budget; it never proves hardness or permits weakening a requirement.

tools.name: feasibility_spikes
tools.description: Read stored feasibility experiments of a component with their outcome, versions and limits of inference. No commands run.

tools.name: checks_view
tools.description: Read the check contract of a task: effective check version, declared properties and actual coverage of the last gates, confirmed/proposed/disputed corpus cases (paginated with cursor), failure history by property, the recovery episode, remaining budgets and the next step with who must act. Read-only; starts nothing.

tools.name: checks_case_submit
tools.description: Submit a concrete input for a declared property. The controller runs the pinned oracle and the implementation on the defective commit twice; only a reproducible discrepancy becomes an immutable corpus version adopted by the listed unfinished tasks (waiting for an active run). Wrong expectations are refuted, timeouts inconclusive; nothing in the input or a reproduction command is executed. Idempotent by key. Removal, replaced expectations, tolerance, checker or command changes are refused: use contract-change.

tools.name: checks_adopt
tools.description: Adopt an existing corpus version by explicitly listed unfinished tasks of the same check contract. Waits for active runs and holds their issuance; accepted tasks are never changed.

tools.name: recovery_decide
tools.description: Record the lead decision for a recovery episode (two failures on one property) with the expected record version: add confirmed cases under the pinned oracle, one retry with a new hypothesis, a proposal for normal review (strengthen checker, split task), a product conflict for the user, or an environment stop. Never resets attempts.

tools.name: contract_change_status
tools.description: Read a contract-change operation: its step, holds, history, earlier redactions and the next step. Read-only.

tools.name: contract_change_revise
tools.description: Revise a failed, stale or waiting contract change to the current committed redaction with the expected record version. Before side effects the same operation is re-reviewed with its history kept; after them a linked successor takes the holds over. Effects are never rolled back.
